label: 2 m
notes: 2 m half of a VHF/UHF LEO satellite pair. RHCP, crossed loops fed by the F5VIF balanced system (100 ohm balanced phasing line, balanced Q-section, half-wave 4:1 coax balun), with a drooping radial reflector to favor high-elevation passes. Round tubing. Targets: axial ratio < 3 dB over the coverage cone, VSWR < 1.5 after matching. Reflector count, spacing, and droop left for the optimizer.
